page.overflow_rule: Render, count pages, and step down through FIT_SCALES until the report is exactly one page. If the smallest scale still overflows, fail instead of saving.

typography.family: Helvetica / Helvetica-Bold (Inter or Open Sans when embedded)
typography.scaling: All sizes except the footer are multiplied by the active fit scale; metric values never scale above 1.0

ink.role: Title, headings, metric values, bold table rows

muted.role: Subtitle, source locations, notes, disclaimer, footer text

coral.role: Hero metric (basic ownership) and the 'Unable to calculate' banner only

rule.role: Table row dividers, metric box border, footer rule

cream.role: Metric strip background; new-investor table row

footer.pattern: [Document title]   [Page #]   Compiled on [Month DD, YYYY] by TEN Capital Network   [TEN Capital logo]
footer.document_title_blocked: [Company name] [Round label] Ownership - Unable to Calculate

calculated.layout:

| [Company name] - [Round label] investor ownership                            |
| Investor: [Investor] | Round: [Round share class] | Cap table as of | Prepared |
+---------------+---------------+---------------+---------------+--------------+
| Check size    | New shares    | BASIC OWN.    | Fully diluted | Post-money   |
| [$X,XXX,XXX]  | [N,NNN,NNN.NN]| [NN.NNN%]*    | [NN.NNN%]     | [$XX,XXX,XXX]|
+---------------+---------------+---------------+---------------+--------------+
| Share math sentence                                                          |
| POST-MONEY VALUATION AND BASIS  [pre + proceeds; implied; bridge]            |

sections.purpose: Identifies company, round, investor and dates.

fields.label: Company
fields.source: Cap table title cell (text before 'Cap Table')

fields.label: Round
fields.source: Name of the round share class in the cap table header, without the 'Preferred (code)' suffix

fields.label: Round security
fields.source: Full round share-class name from the cap table

sections.pattern:
{company} - {round_label} investor ownership
Investor: {investor} | Round: {round_class_name} (priced) | Cap table as of {cap_table_as_of} | Prepared {prepared_date}

sections.purpose: Five headline figures in one strip; basic ownership is the single coral hero value.

fields.label: Check size
fields.source: --check-size, or the full open allocation when stated unambiguously

fields.label: Basic ownership
fields.source: Investor After shares / After issued and outstanding shares

fields.label: Fully diluted ownership
fields.source: Investor After shares / After fully diluted shares

fields.label: Post-money valuation
fields.source: Priced pre-money + proceeds in the modelled financing

rules: Labels on one line, values on the next, centred, five equal columns.

sections.purpose: Shows how the new share count was derived and what each ownership basis contains.

fields.label: Fractional-share note
fields.source: Stated convention, else the confirmation note

sections.pattern: New shares = {check_size_exact} / {share_price} = {new_shares_exact} (unrounded; {fraction_note}). Basic = issued and outstanding common + preferred ({after_basic_shares} after); fully diluted adds options/RSUs and the unissued pool ({after_fd_shares} after).

sections.heading: Post-money valuation and basis
sections.purpose: States the post-money, its components and source, the implied priced valuations on both share bases, and a bridge that explains every dollar of difference.

fields.label: Pre-money
fields.source: Deck (single consistent figure), --pre-money, or price x pre-round outstanding shares

fields.label: Pre-money source
fields.source: Exact location(s) of the pre-money figure

fields.label: Proceeds components
fields.source: Issued round cash + commitment rows in Before [+ commitments not in cap table] [+ kept plug row] + this check; zero-value optional components omitted

fields.label: Implied pre-money (outstanding)
fields.source: price x (Before outstanding - all round shares)

fields.label: Implied pre-money (fully diluted)
fields.source: price x (Before fully diluted - all round shares)

sections.pattern: {post_money} = pre-money {pre_money} ({pre_money_source}) + proceeds {proceeds} ({proceeds_breakdown}). Implied priced valuations at {share_price}/share: pre-money {implied_pre_basic} on outstanding shares ({implied_pre_fd} fully diluted); post-money {implied_post_basic} on outstanding shares ({implied_post_fd} fully diluted). The {post_gap} gap to the stated-basis post-money comes from {bridge_items}.
rules: Never label price x outstanding shares as a fully diluted valuation.

sections.heading: Ownership by class: Before (source pro forma) -> After
sections.purpose: Every security class in the source, Before and After, with the investor's line kept distinct.

fields.label: Class rows
fields.source: calc.Result.classes in source order: common, preferred series, warrants, options/RSUs, unissued pool

sections.rows: One row per class, then Total (bold), then the investor row (cream, bold).
rules: Basic % columns print 'excl.' for warrants, options/RSUs and the unissued pool.
Share counts: whole numbers without decimals. Change column: percentage points, 3 dp, '0.000 pp' when the rounded change is zero.
Preferred classes are counted 1:1 as converted.

sections.purpose: Tie-out status and how the round adjustments were applied.

fields.label: Tie-outs
fields.source: First three calc checks: outstanding, fully diluted, class totals (OK / FAIL)

fields.label: Plug-row clause
fields.source: Present only when an unsold plug row is released
fields.placeholder: and removes the unsold plug row '[row label]' ([N,NNN,NNN.NN] sh) through a separate adjustment

fields.label: Commitments clause
fields.placeholder: [Commitments already in the pro forma are not added again. | Commitments not in the cap table are added as one aggregate row.]

sections.pattern: Before ties to the source: {tie_out_statuses}. {round_label} After includes the new investor{plug_clause}. {commitments_clause}

sections.heading: Top 3 data issues
sections.purpose: The three most material source problems: severity first, then materiality priority. INFO items never appear.

fields.label: Source
fields.source: Up to four exact locations (Sheet!Cell, Slide N)

rules: Exactly three items when three or more non-INFO issues exist; fewer otherwise.
Empty state: 'No material data issues found.'

sections.heading: Sources and assumptions
sections.purpose: Every resolved input with its exact source, then the fixed treatment statement.

fields.label: Source
fields.source: Workbook, tab and cell, deck slide and quoted label, or CLI flag

sections.fixed_text: Treatment: preferred at 1:1; options/RSUs and pool excluded from basic, included in fully diluted; no pool top-up modelled unless sourced; convertibles listed without share counts not added.
rules: Items joined inline with bullet separators.

| [Company name] - [Round label] investor ownership                            |
| Investor: [Investor] | Cap table as of [date] | Prepared [date]              |
| UNABLE TO CALCULATE (coral)                                                  |
| Explanation: no ownership %, share count or valuation is shown               |

| Disclaimer                                                                   |
